title: Auto apply to jobs with clear review and control | SearchBreaker
description: Submit selected applications through a controlled workflow when automatic submission is actually supported. Learn the workflow, its controls and what you can review before applying.

blocks.headline: Auto apply to jobs with clear review and control
blocks.lead: Speed matters, but quality matters more. Auto apply is designed to send only the applications you selected, under rules you set, with every material and result visible to you.

blocks.reassurance: Nothing is sent outside rules you approved.

blocks.heading: How application submission works
blocks.lead: Three steps sit between a saved job and a submitted application. You control each one.

steps.title: Selection rules
steps.text: You define which jobs are eligible, such as roles, fit and sources. Nothing outside the rules is sent.

steps.title: Approval mode
steps.text: Choose to approve each application, or to review a daily summary before anything goes out.

steps.title: Submission confirmation
steps.text: After each submission you see the result and a copy of what was sent.

blocks.heading: What you can review
blocks.lead: Before and after every submission, the details are yours to check.

points.title: The resume version

points.title: The answers

points.title: The timing

blocks.heading: Where auto apply is supported
blocks.emptyText: Automatic submission is only offered on platforms we have tested and where it is allowed. Until then, no platform is listed and no automatic submission is available.
blocks.footnote: Platforms not listed here are not supported. Each platform sets its own rules, and we follow them.

blocks.heading: Auto apply versus autofill
blocks.lead: The difference is who presses submit.

values.auto: Prepares and sends applications that match rules you set.
values.autofill: Fills application fields from your verified profile.

values.auto: SearchBreaker, only under rules you approved. You can pause it at any time.

auto.text: Sent back to you, never guessed

blocks.heading: What auto apply does not do

items.title: It does not apply to everything
items.text: Only jobs that match your rules, on platforms where it is supported and allowed.

items.title: It does not guess answers
items.text: Questions it cannot answer from your verified profile are sent back to you.

items.title: It does not promise results
items.text: Sending an application does not mean a reply. Volume is not a goal in itself.

faqs.a: It is designed against spam. Only jobs that match your rules are eligible, and you can require approval for every application.

faqs.q: Is it compliant with each platform?
faqs.a: Each platform has its own terms. Automatic submission is offered only where it has been tested and is allowed. Otherwise it is not offered.

faqs.q: Can I see exactly what was sent?
faqs.a: Yes. Each submitted application keeps a copy of the job, resume version and answers, with the time it was sent.

faqs.q: What happens if a submission fails?
faqs.a: The application is marked as failed and the record shows the reason. Nothing is retried without your approval.
Pause auto apply at any time. Approved rules stop working the moment you pause them.
